name: ruvos-google-docs
description: Create and edit Google Docs in place via the Docs API (documents.batchUpdate): headings, lists, tables, page breaks, text color and highlight, headers, footers, inline images, and follow-up edits. A native table of contents is Insert → Table of contents in the Doc UI after headings are written. A horizontal rule is Insert → Horizontal line in the Doc UI. Images upload with drive.file, not a hosted URL and not full Drive. Ruvos OAuth DCR — no Google client secret in Cursor. Not Word, not HTML, not a markdown upload.
